Title: MCP Integration Friction
Content: VS Code MCP configuration pointed at MemorySmith before the app exposed an MCP endpoint, which caused /mcp probes to return 404 or 405. MemorySmith exposes an HTTP MCP-compatible JSON-RPC endpoint for model context protocol tool calling; its 22-tool catalog covers lexical search, hybrid search (which fuses the semantic signal), context packs, record lookup, page and task tools, governed memory write tools, code search, source bundles, and source-link back-mapping, plus the opt-in agent session tools (memorysmith_agent_invoke / memorysmith_agent_session_end). The workspace .vscode/mcp.json should point directly at http://localhost:5089/mcp.
